Welcome to Find The Italian Brainrot! Search through the map and collect Brainrots!

JOIN OUR GROUP FOR FREE BRAINROT  https://www.roblox.com/communities/35605753/Potato-Studios-Scavenger

🔎 Explore the maps to find all of the hidden Brainrots!
🏃 Use sprint to complete obbies easier
🏆 Find all Brainrots to win!

🌴 Some Brainrots are very well hidden. Find cool Brainrots with friends and meet new friends along the way! 🌴

45 Brainrots
4 Maps

New updates coming very soon!

If you want to suggest NEW Brainrots post a message on the Potato Group wall. Let us know if you find a bug.
